info.title: Get Image Translation Tasks
info.description:
Retrieves the image translation task status and translated images for one or more previously submitted images.
**Note**: Please wait 5 minutes after [task creation](684f8b2d6e0b37048b2448b4) before calling this API, and retry at intervals over 10 seconds to avoid rate limiting.
Applicable only for sellers that sell across EU.

get.description:
Retrieves the image translation task status and translated images for one or more previously submitted images.
**Note**: Please wait 5 minutes after [task creation](684f8b2d6e0b37048b2448b4) before calling this API, and retry at intervals over 10 seconds to avoid rate limiting.
Applicable only for sellers that sell across EU.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: translation_task_ids
parameters.description:
The image translation task IDs for retrieving translation results.
Max count: 20

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

uri.description: The URI of the original image.

url.description: The URL of the original image.

original_image.description: The original image to be translated.

id.description: The ID to identify the image translation task.

target_language.description:
The target language to translate the image into.
Possible values:
- de-DE
- en-IE
- es-ES
- fr-FR
- it-IT

status.description:
The translation result.
Possible values:
- PROCESSING: Translation is underway and has not yet completed.
- COMPLETED: Translation has completed and results are ready.
- FAILED: Translation did not complete due to an error.

fail_reason.description:
The reason why the translation task failed.
Possible values:
- Invalid image URI.
- Internal processing error, please try calling this endpoint again.
- This image can't be translated. Try a different image.
fail_reason.example: This image can't be translated. Try a different image.

uri.description: The URI of the translated image.

url.description: The URL of the translated image.

translation_tasks.description: The requested translation tasks and the corresponding results. Each task corresponds to the translation of 1 image into 1 target language.
